component_name: Adaptive Intelligent Synthetic Data Repair Engine
description: Validated synthetic repair package produced by C3. Sent to C4 for release decision.

input_context.note: C3 receives input from C1 (drift evidence), C2 (repair specification), and data_context from the platform orchestrator. These are documented here for clarity but are not part of the C3 output schema.

repair_dataset_uri.description: Path to the validated synthetic repair dataset. C4 uses this to retrain the candidate model.

repair_package_status.description: Overall validation status. C3 only sends APPROVED packages to C4. REJECTED triggers re-generation internally.

generator.description: Generative model selected by the Repair Prescription Engine for this condition.

n_synthetic_rows.description: Number of synthetic rows generated. Determined by the Repair Prescription Engine based on drift severity and slice support.

augmentation_ratio.description: Ratio of synthetic rows to original training data. 0.30 means 30% augmentation.

fidelity_score.description: Statistical fidelity of synthetic data vs real data distributions.

utility_score.description: Downstream model accuracy improvement on affected slice when trained with synthetic data.

privacy_status.description: Distance to Closest Record (DCR) privacy check result. C4 hard gate rejects FAIL packages.

target_coverage.description: Fraction of synthetic rows falling within the affected_slice_rule from C2. High coverage means repair targets the right population.

prescription_confidence.description: Repair Prescription Engine confidence in its generator and quantity selection.

repair_version.description: Version identifier for this repair package. Referenced in C4 audit trail.

repair_timestamp.description: Timestamp when the repair package was produced.

notes: C4 must reject the repair package if privacy_status is FAIL regardless of other scores
C4 hard_gate_status.privacy_check must read C3 privacy_status directly
repair_version links to C4 upstream_evidence_summary.c3.repair_version for audit tracing
data_context is NOT passed through C1 or C2. It is injected by the platform orchestrator from onboarding config.
During independent development, Kesigan generates repair data himself using CTGAN or TVAE and computes these scores directly
